descriptionByLocale.it:
Banking Operations è una linea di servizio strategica Avaloq che fornisce servizi di outsourcing Banking Operations alle banche. Siamo organizzati come Business Area Globale, in esecuzione di servizi di backoffice all'avanguardia con l'automazione leader del settore, la qualità e gli standard di rischio. Siamo esperti nel fornire un vero valore aggiunto ai nostri clienti e quindi, sempre guardare per aggiungere personalità creative e orientate al cliente con spinta e passione al nostro team.
Il Corporate Actions Processing Team gestisce eventi provenienti dal mercato che influenzano la caratteristica, la natura o il valore di una sicurezza. Questi eventi possono essere obbligatori, obbligatori con opzioni o volontari. L'attività comprende gestione delle istruzioni, gestione delle transazioni e gestione delle indagini per tali eventi.
I compiti chiave

• Elaborazione e prenotazione di eventi obbligatori e volontari

• Gestione delle istruzioni ai custodi (ad esempio, via MT565) o tramite sistemi esterni

• Effettuare conciliazioni in denaro e azioni

• Gestione del cliente e delle richieste interne

## Qualifiche

• Capacità di muoversi autonomamente in un ambiente altamente impegnativo, veloce e complesso

• Eccellente comunicazione e capacità organizzative

• Buon giocatore di squadra e atteggiamento positivo

• Flessibilità e disponibilità ad imparare

• Fluency in inglese
Sarebbe un vero bonus se avessi

• Know-how nell'area Azioni Aziendali (sia eventi volontari che obbligatori)

• Conoscenza di Avaloq Core Banking System

• Conoscenza delle lingue aggiuntive

## Informazioni

Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare ancora la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali.
In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e comprendere il successo del nostro business è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico.
Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altro fantastico tratto che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro.
Si prega di essere consapevoli che non accetteremo le candidature speculative per uno qualsiasi dei nostri ruoli da agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi presentazione candidato non richiesto sarà esente da eventuali aspettative di pagamento.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Banking Operations is a strategic Avaloq service line providing Banking Operations outsourcing services to banks. We are organized as a global Business Area, running state-of-the art Backoffice services with industry leading automation, quality, and risk standards. We are experts in providing a true value add to our clients and thus, always look to add creative and client-oriented personalities with drive and passion to our team.
The Corporate Actions Processing Team manage events coming from the market affecting the characteristic, the nature, or the value of a security. These events can be mandatory, mandatory with options or voluntary. The activity includes instruction management, transaction management and inquiry management for such events.
Your key tasks

• Processing and booking of mandatory and voluntary corporate action events

• Managing instructions to custodians (e.g., via MT565) or through external systems

• Performing cash and stock reconciliations

• Handling client and internal inquiries

## Qualifiche

• Capability to autonomously get around in a highly challenging, fast-paced and complex environment

• Excellent communication and organization skills

• Good team player and positive attitude

• Flexibility and willingness to learn

• Fluency in English
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Know-how in the Corporate Actions area (both voluntary and mandatory events)

• Knowledge of Avaloq Core Banking System

• Knowledge of additional languages

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

Banking Operations ist eine strategische Avaloq-Servicelinie, die Banken Outsourcing-Dienstleistungen anbietet. Wir sind als globales Geschäftsfeld organisiert und betreiben hochmoderne Backoffice-Services mit branchenführenden Automatisierungs-, Qualitäts- und Risikostandards. Wir sind Experten darin, unseren Kunden einen echten Mehrwert zu bieten, und versuchen daher, unserem Team immer kreative und kundenorientierte Persönlichkeiten mit Antrieb und Leidenschaft hinzuzufügen.
Das Corporate Actions Processing Team verwaltet Ereignisse, die vom Markt kommen und sich auf die Charakteristik, die Art oder den Wert eines Wertpapiers auswirken. Diese Veranstaltungen können obligatorisch, obligatorisch mit Optionen oder freiwillig sein. Die Aktivität umfasst Instruktionsmanagement, Transaktionsmanagement und Anfragemanagement für solche Ereignisse.
Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben

• Bearbeitung und Buchung von verpflichtenden und freiwilligen Corporate Action Events

• Verwaltung von Anweisungen an Verwahrstellen (z. B. über MT565) oder über externe Systeme

• Durchführung von Bar- und Bestandsabstimmungen

• Bearbeitung von Kunden- und internen Anfragen

## Qualifiziert

• Fähigkeit, sich autonom in einer sehr anspruchsvollen, schnelllebigen und komplexen Umgebung fortzubewegen

• Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten

• Guter Teamplayer und positive Einstellung

• Flexibilität und Lernbereitschaft

• Fluency in Englisch
Es wäre ein echter Bonus, wenn Sie

• Know-how im Bereich Corporate Actions (sowohl freiwillige als auch obligatorische Veranstaltungen)

• Kenntnisse des Avaloq Core Banking Systems

• Kenntnisse zusätzlicher Sprachen

## Informazioni aggiuntive

Wir wissen, dass das Management der Work-Life-Balance eine Herausforderung ist, der wir alle in unserem täglichen Leben gegenüberstehen, und um dies zu unterstützen, freuen wir uns, den meisten unserer Avaloqer ein hybrides und flexibles Arbeiten anzubieten, um die Work-Life-Balance zu erhalten und unsere fantastische Avaloq-Kultur in unseren globalen Büros fortzusetzen.
Bei Avaloq sind wir stolz darauf, Vielfalt anzunehmen und zu verstehen, dass der Erfolg unseres Unternehmens auf der Kraft unterschiedlicher Meinungen basiert, wir sind von ganzem Herzen bestrebt, eine Chancengleichheit und eine integrative Kultur zu fördern, in der Sie Ihr wahres authentisches Selbst sein können.
Wir stellen, kompensieren und fördern unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung oder anderen fantastischen Eigenschaften, die uns alle einzigartig machen, wir haben unser Bestes getan, um diese Anzeige in einer integrativen und neutralen Weise zu schreiben.
Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir keine spekulativen CV-Einreichungen für unsere Rollen von Rekrutierungsagenturen annehmen werden und dass unerwünschte Kandidateneinreichungen von Zahlungserwartungen ausgenommen sind.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Corporate Real Estate Manager guida importanti iniziative immobiliari e progetti a Zurigo, supportando l’esecuzione della strategia globale Corporate Real Estate di Avaloq nel suo portafoglio internazionale.
Il ruolo è responsabile della fornitura di progetti immobiliari e sul posto di lavoro, della gestione del contratto di locazione e delle attività relative al portafoglio, e della garanzia di una governance efficace del progetto, della rendicontazione, dei controlli finanziari e dell'impegno degli stakeholder, nonché della gestione delle strutture locali. Lavorando a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interni, la leadership senior, i proprietari, i consulenti e i partner esterni, il Corporate Real Estate Manager bilancia più priorità, gestisce i programmi complessi e garantisce la consegna di successo attraverso una forte gestione del progetto, un acume commerciale e l'eccellenza operativa.
I compiti chiave

• Guidare la pianificazione e la consegna di progetti immobiliari, di lavoro e di portafoglio, tra cui espansioni di uffici, trasferimenti, ristrutturazioni, consolidamenti e iniziative di trasformazione del posto di lavoro.

• Supporta l'implementazione della strategia Corporate Real Estate di Avaloq in tutto il portafoglio di proprietà globale.

• Gestisci i progetti in tutto il ciclo di vita, tra cui sviluppo di casi aziendali, pianificazione, approvvigionamento, governance, consegna, handover e revisione post-project.

• Condurre o sostenere le trattative di locazione, i rinnovi, le recensioni di affitto e le relazioni del proprietario.

• Sviluppare casi aziendali, proposte di investimento, analisi di portafoglio e raccomandazioni per sostenere il processo decisionale strategico.

• Stabilire e mantenere efficace la governance del progetto, i quadri di reporting, le approvazioni, i registri dei rischi e i processi di controllo.

• Monitorare e segnalare le prestazioni del progetto, i budget, le previsioni, le pietre miliari, i rischi e i portachiavi.

• Assicurare una gestione finanziaria robusta attraverso il controllo del bilancio, la previsione, il monitoraggio dei costi, la gestione degli ordini di acquisto e la gestione delle fatture.

• Coordinare gli stakeholder interni, i leader aziendali, i proprietari, i broker, i consulenti, gli appaltatori e i fornitori di servizi per fornire risultati di progetto di successo.

• Gestisci i rischi del progetto, i problemi, le dipendenze e i controlli di cambiamento, assicurando la mitigazione e l'escalation appropriate, se necessario.

• Mantenere la documentazione accurata del progetto, i pacchetti di report, i record di governance e i percorsi di audit.

• Supporta le attività di approvvigionamento, i processi di selezione dei fornitori, i negoziati contrattuali e la gestione delle prestazioni dei fornitori.

• Ottimizzazione, sostenibilità, efficienza dei costi e iniziative di miglioramento continuo nel portafoglio immobiliare.

• Fornire un supporto consultivo in materia di lavoro e di proprietà, lavorando con team operativi e fornitori di servizi, laddove necessario.

• Costruire e mantenere forti relazioni con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, garantendo allineamento, impegno e una comunicazione efficace durante la consegna del progetto.

• Servire come responsabile della sicurezza in loco (SIBE ), garantire la sicurezza sul posto di lavoro per il personale e gli appaltatori esterni. Pianifica, piombo e log esercitazioni periodiche di evacuazione obbligatoria.

## Qualifiche

• Laurea magistrale in Immobili, Business Administration, Ingegneria, Architettura, Construction Management, Project Management, o una disciplina relativa.

• 10+ anni di esperienza nel settore immobiliare aziendale, gestione del portafoglio, transazioni immobiliari, gestione del progetto o trasformazione del posto di lavoro.

• Esperienza comprovata che conduce complessi progetti immobiliari e programmi all'interno di un ambiente internazionale.

• Forte conoscenza della gestione del contratto di locazione, trattative del proprietario, pianificazione del portafoglio, operazioni di proprietà e la consegna del progetto.

• Esperienza dimostrabile nella governance, gestione finanziaria, reporting, controlli e gestione dei rischi.

• Esperienza di preparazione di casi aziendali, rapporti di gestione, carte di bordo e raccomandazioni strategiche.

• Eccellente gestione delle parti interessate, comunicazione, negoziazione e competenze influenti.

• Esperienza di fornitori, consulenti, appaltatori e partner esterni.

• Familiarità con le normative sulla sicurezza sul posto di lavoro e l'esperienza precedente che agiscono come responsabile della sicurezza del sito (SIBE) o la gestione di concetti di emergenza per edifici

• La qualifica di Project Management (PRINCE2 o equivalente) è altamente auspicabile.

• Avanzate competenze Microsoft Office, in particolare Excel e PowerPoint.

• Fluency in tedesco e inglese.

• Ulteriori competenze linguistiche francesi o italiane sarebbero vantaggiose.
Che cosa porta

• Un approccio strategico e commercialmente pensato combinato con forti abilità di esecuzione.

• La capacità di gestire più priorità e stakeholders all'interno di un ambiente internazionale veloce.

• Forte negoziazione, influenza e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder.

• Una mentalità proattiva, strutturata, analitica e orientata alla soluzione.

• Un forte focus sul miglioramento continuo, l'eccellenza operativa e la consegna di risultati aziendali misurabili

• Confidenza che lavora con i leader senior e che rappresenta Corporate Real Estate in tutta l'organizzazione.

## Informazioni

Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare ancora la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali.
In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e comprendere il successo del nostro business è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico.
Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altro fantastico tratto che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Corporate Real Estate Manager leads key real estate initiatives and projects in Zurich while supporting the execution of Avaloq’s global Corporate Real Estate strategy across its international portfolio.
The role is responsible for delivering real estate and workplace projects, managing lease and portfolio-related activities, and ensuring effective project governance, reporting, financial controls, and stakeholder engagement, as well as driving local facility management matters. Working closely with internal stakeholders, senior leadership, landlords, consultants, and external partners, the Corporate Real Estate Manager balances multiple priorities, manages complex programmes, and ensures successful delivery through strong project management, commercial acumen, and operational excellence.
Your key tasks

• Lead the planning and delivery of real estate, workplace, and portfolio projects, including office expansions, relocations, refurbishments, consolidations, and workplace transformation initiatives.

• Support the implementation of Avaloq's Corporate Real Estate strategy across the global property portfolio.

• Manage projects throughout the full lifecycle, including business case development, planning, procurement, governance, delivery, handover, and post-project review.

• Lead or support lease negotiations, renewals, rent reviews, and landlord relationships.

• Develop business cases, investment proposals, portfolio analyses, and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.

• Establish and maintain effective project governance, reporting frameworks, approvals, risk registers, and control processes.

• Monitor and report on project performance, budgets, forecasts, milestones, risks, and key deliverables.

• Ensure robust financial management through budget control, forecasting, cost tracking, purchase order management, and invoice governance.

• Coordinate internal stakeholders, business leaders, landlords, brokers, consultants, contractors, and service providers to deliver successful project outcomes.

• Manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and change controls, ensuring appropriate mitigation and escalation where required.

• Maintain accurate project documentation, reporting packs, governance records, and audit trails.

• Support procurement activities, supplier selection processes, contract negotiations, and vendor performance management.

• Drive portfolio optimisation, sustainability, cost efficiency, and continuous improvement initiatives across the real estate portfolio.

• Provide advisory support on workplace and property matters, working with operational teams and service providers where required.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment, engagement, and effective communication throughout project delivery.

• Serve as the on-site Safety Officer ( SIBE ), ensure workplace safety for staff and external contractors. Plan, lead, and log mandatory periodic evacuation drills.

## Qualifiche

• Master's degree in Real Estate, Business Administration, Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.

• 10+ years of experience in corporate real estate, portfolio management, property transactions, project management, or workplace transformation.

• Proven experience leading complex real estate projects and programmes within an international environment.

• Strong knowledge of lease management, landlord negotiations, portfolio planning, property transactions, and project delivery.

• Demonstrable experience in governance, financial management, reporting, controls, and risk management.

• Experience preparing business cases, management reports, board papers, and strategic recommendations.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.

• Experience managing suppliers, consultants, contractors, and external partners.

• Familiarity with Swiss workplace safety regulations and prior experience acting as a site Safety Officer ( SIBE ) or managing building emergency concepts

• Project Management qualification (PRINCE2 or equivalent) is highly desirable.

• Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

• Fluency in German and English.

• Additional French or Italian language skills would be beneficial.
What You Bring

• A strategic and commercially minded approach combined with strong execution skills.

• The ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders within a fast-paced international environment.

• Strong negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder management capabilities.

• A proactive, structured, analytical, and solution-oriented mindset.

• A strong focus on continuous improvement, operational excellence, and delivery of measurable business outcomes

• Confidence working with senior leaders and representing Corporate Real Estate across the organisation.

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Der Corporate Real Estate Manager leitet wichtige Immobilieninitiativen und -projekte in Zürich und unterstützt gleichzeitig die Umsetzung der globalen Corporate Real Estate Strategie von Avaloq im gesamten internationalen Portfolio.
Die Rolle ist verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung von Immobilien- und Arbeitsplatzprojekten, die Verwaltung von Leasing- und portfoliobezogenen Aktivitäten und die Gewährleistung einer effektiven Projektsteuerung, Berichterstattung, Finanzkontrollen und Einbeziehung der Stakeholder sowie die Förderung lokaler Facility-Management-Angelegenheiten. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern, Führungskräften, Vermietern, Beratern und externen Partnern balanciert der Corporate Real Estate Manager mehrere Prioritäten, verwaltet komplexe Programme und gewährleistet eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung durch starkes Projektmanagement, kommerziellen Scharfsinn und operative Exzellenz.
Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben

• Führen Sie die Planung und Lieferung von Immobilien-, Arbeitsplatz- und Portfolioprojekten, einschließlich Büroerweiterungen, Umsiedlungen, Renovierungen, Konsolidierungen und Arbeitsplatztransformationsinitiativen.

• Unterstützung der Umsetzung der Avaloq Corporate Real Estate Strategie im gesamten globalen Immobilienportfolio.

• Verwalten Sie Projekte während des gesamten Lebenszyklus, einschließlich der Entwicklung von Geschäftsfällen, Planung, Beschaffung, Governance, Lieferung, Übergabe und Überprüfung nach dem Projekt.

• Führen oder unterstützen Sie Mietvertragsverhandlungen, Verlängerungen, Mietbewertungen und Vermieterbeziehungen.

• Entwicklung von Business Cases, Anlagevorschlägen, Portfolioanalysen und Empfehlungen zur Unterstützung strategischer Entscheidungen.

• Etablieren und pflegen Sie eine effektive Projektsteuerung, Berichtsrahmen, Genehmigungen, Risikoregister und Kontrollprozesse.

• Überwachen und berichten Sie über die Projektleistung, Budgets, Prognosen, Meilensteine, Risiken und wichtige Ergebnisse.

• Gewährleistung eines robusten Finanzmanagements durch Budgetkontrolle, Prognose, Kostenverfolgung, Bestellverwaltung und Rechnungsführung.

• Koordinieren Sie interne Stakeholder, Führungskräfte, Vermieter, Makler, Berater, Auftragnehmer und Dienstleister, um erfolgreiche Projektergebnisse zu liefern.

• Verwalten Sie Projektrisiken, Probleme, Abhängigkeiten und Änderungskontrollen, um bei Bedarf eine angemessene Minderung und Eskalation zu gewährleisten.

• Pflegen Sie genaue Projektdokumentation, Reporting Packs, Governance Records und Audit Trails.

• Unterstützung von Beschaffungsaktivitäten, Lieferantenauswahlprozessen, Vertragsverhandlungen und Lieferantenleistungsmanagement.

• Förderung von Portfoliooptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit, Kosteneffizienz und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen im gesamten Immobilienportfolio.

• Beratung bei Arbeitsplatz- und Immobilienfragen und bei Bedarf Zusammenarbeit mit Betriebsteams und Dienstleistern.

• Aufbau und Pflege starker Beziehungen zu internen und externen Stakeholdern, um die Ausrichtung, das Engagement und die effektive Kommunikation während der gesamten Projektabwicklung sicherzustellen.

• Als Sicherheitsbeauftragter vor Ort (SIBE) sorgen Sie für die Sicherheit am Arbeitsplatz für Mitarbeiter und externe Auftragnehmer. Planen, führen und protokollieren Sie obligatorische periodische Evakuierungsübungen.

## Qualifiziert

• Master-Abschluss in Immobilien, Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen, Architektur, Baumanagement, Projektmanagement oder einer verwandten Disziplin.

• 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in Corporate Real Estate, Portfoliomanagement, Immobilientransaktionen, Projektmanagement oder Arbeitsplatztransformation.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Immobilienprojekte und -programme in einem internationalen Umfeld.

• Starkes Wissen über Leasingmanagement, Vermieterverhandlungen, Portfolioplanung, Immobilientransaktionen und Projektlieferung.

• Nachweisbare Erfahrung in Governance, Finanzmanagement, Reporting, Kontrollen und Risikomanagement.

• Erfahrung in der Vorbereitung von Geschäftsfällen, Managementberichten, Board Papers und strategischen Empfehlungen.

• Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management, Kommunikation, Verhandlung und Einflussnahme auf Fähigkeiten.

• Erfahrung im Management von Lieferanten, Beratern, Auftragnehmern und externen Partnern.

• Vertrautheit mit den schweizerischen Arbeitsschutzvorschriften und Vorkenntnissen als Baustelle Safety Officer (SIBE) oder Management von Gebäude-Notfallkonzepten

• Projektmanagement Qualifikation (PRINCE2 oder gleichwertig) ist sehr wünschenswert.

• Erweiterte Microsoft Office-Fähigkeiten, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint.

• Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch.

• Zusätzliche Französisch- oder Italienischkenntnisse wären von Vorteil.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le Corporate Real Estate Manager dirige des initiatives et des projets immobiliers clés à Zurich tout en soutenant l'exécution de la stratégie mondiale d'Avaloq.
Ce rôle consiste à exécuter des projets immobiliers et en milieu de travail, à gérer des contrats de location et des activités liées au portefeuille et à veiller à l'efficacité de la gouvernance des projets, à l'établissement de rapports, aux contrôles financiers et à la participation des intervenants, ainsi qu'à la gestion des installations locales. En étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes, les dirigeants, les propriétaires, les consultants et les partenaires externes, le directeur immobilier de l'entreprise équilibre plusieurs priorités, gère des programmes complexes et assure la réussite de l'exécution grâce à une gestion de projet solide, à un sens commercial et à l'excellence opérationnelle.
Vos tâches clés

• Diriger la planification et l'exécution de projets immobiliers, d'aménagement du lieu de travail et de portefeuille, y compris les agrandissements de bureaux, les réinstallations, les rénovations, les regroupements et les initiatives de transformation du lieu de travail.

• Soutenir la mise en œuvre de la stratégie immobilière d'Avaloq dans le portefeuille immobilier mondial.

• Gérer les projets tout au long du cycle de vie, y compris l'élaboration d'analyses de rentabilisation, la planification, l'approvisionnement, la gouvernance, la prestation, le transfert et l'examen après le projet.

• Mener ou soutenir les négociations de bail, les renouvellements, les examens des loyers et les relations de propriétaire.

• Élaborer des analyses de rentabilisation, des propositions d'investissement, des analyses de portefeuille et des recommandations pour appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques.

• Établir et maintenir une gouvernance de projet efficace, des cadres de rapport, des approbations, des registres des risques et des processus de contrôle.

• Surveiller le rendement du projet, les budgets, les prévisions, les jalons, les risques et les principaux produits livrables et en rendre compte.

• Assurer une gestion financière solide grâce au contrôle budgétaire, aux prévisions, au suivi des coûts, à la gestion des bons de commande et à la gouvernance des factures.

• Coordonner les intervenants internes, les chefs d'entreprise, les propriétaires, les courtiers, les consultants, les entrepreneurs et les fournisseurs de services afin d'obtenir les résultats du projet.

• Gérer les risques, les enjeux, les dépendances et les contrôles du changement, en assurant une atténuation et une escalade appropriées au besoin.

• Tenir à jour la documentation exacte du projet, les trousses de rapports, les dossiers de gouvernance et les pistes de vérification.

• Appuyer les activités d'approvisionnement, les processus de sélection des fournisseurs, les négociations contractuelles et la gestion du rendement des fournisseurs.

• Favoriser l'optimisation du portefeuille, la durabilité, l'efficacité des coûts et des initiatives d'amélioration continue dans l'ensemble du portefeuille immobilier.

• Fournir un soutien consultatif en matière de milieu de travail et de biens, en collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles et les fournisseurs de services au besoin.

• Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les intervenants internes et externes, en assurant l'harmonisation, l'engagement et une communication efficace tout au long de l'exécution du projet.

• Servir d'agent de sécurité sur place (SIBE), assurer la sécurité au travail pour le personnel et les entrepreneurs externes. Planifier, diriger et enregistrer les exercices d'évacuation périodiques obligatoires.

## Qualifiche

• Maîtrise en immobilier, administration des affaires, ingénierie, architecture, gestion de la construction, gestion de projet ou discipline connexe.

• 10 ans et plus d'expérience en immobilier d'entreprise, gestion de portefeuille, transactions immobilières, gestion de projet ou transformation du lieu de travail.

• Expérience éprouvée menant des projets et des programmes immobiliers complexes dans un environnement international.

• Bonne connaissance de la gestion du bail, des négociations avec les propriétaires, de la planification du portefeuille, des transactions immobilières et de l'exécution des projets.

• Expérience démontrée en matière de gouvernance, de gestion financière, de rapports, de contrôles et de gestion des risques.

• Expérience de la préparation d'analyses de rentabilisation, de rapports de gestion, de documents du conseil et de recommandations stratégiques.

• Excellente gestion des intervenants, communication, négociation et influence des compétences.

• Expérience de la gestion des fournisseurs, des consultants, des entrepreneurs et des partenaires externes.

• Connaissance de la réglementation suisse en matière de sécurité sur le lieu de travail et expérience antérieure en tant qu'agent de sécurité du site ( SIBE ) ou gestion des concepts d'urgence dans les bâtiments

• La qualification en gestion de projet (PRINCE2 ou équivalent) est hautement souhaitable.

• Compétences avancées de Microsoft Office, particulièrement Excel et PowerPoint.

• Connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais.

• Des compétences supplémentaires en français ou en italien seraient bénéfiques.
Ce que vous apportez

• Une approche stratégique et commerciale combinée à de solides compétences d'exécution.

• La capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et parties prenantes dans un environnement international rapide.

• Forte capacité de négociation, d'influence et de gestion des intervenants.

• Un état d'esprit proactif, structuré, analytique et axé sur la solution.

• Mettre fortement l'accent sur l'amélioration continue, l'excellence opérationnelle et la réalisation de résultats opérationnels mesurables

• Confiance en travaillant avec des dirigeants et en représentant l'entreprise immobilière dans toute l'organisation.

## Informations complémentaires

Nous nous rendons compte que la gestion de l'équilibre de vie au travail est un défi auquel nous sommes tous confrontés dans notre vie quotidienne et pour soutenir avec cela nous sommes heureux d'offrir un travail hybride et flexible pour la plupart de nos Avaloqers pour maintenir l'équilibre de vie au travail et pour continuer notre fantastique culture Avaloq dans nos bureaux mondiaux.
À Avaloq, nous sommes fiers d'embrasser la diversité et de comprendre que le succès de notre entreprise est fondé sur la puissance des différentes opinions, nous sommes tout à fait engagés à favoriser un environnement d'égalité des chances et une culture inclusive où vous pouvez être votre véritable soi authentique.
Nous recrutons, compensons et promouvons indépendamment de l'origine, de l'âge, de l'identité de genre, de l'orientation sexuelle ou de tout autre caractère fantastique qui nous rend uniques, nous avons fait de notre mieux pour écrire cette annonce de manière inclusive et neutre.
Veuillez noter que nous n'accepterons aucune soumission de CV spéculative pour l'un de nos rôles des agences de recrutement, et toute soumission non sollicitée sera exemptée de toute attente de paiement.

Stiamo cercando un appassionato Cloud Security Architect per unirci al nostro team di Cloud Architecture. Questo ruolo combina l'architettura cloud e l'ingegneria della sicurezza con l'automazione e le pratiche DevSecOps per aiutare la progettazione e la sicurezza di piattaforme e servizi cloud di nuova generazione.

I vostri compiti chiave

• Progettazione, governare e evolvere continuamente architetture cloud sicure per SaaS, PaaS e piattaforme interne

• Definire e mantenere gli standard di sicurezza cloud, modelli di architettura riutilizzabili, architetture di riferimento e progetti di sicurezza

• Incorpora i principi di sicurezza per progetto nelle zone di atterraggio, nelle strutture di atterraggio, nella segmentazione di rete, nei modelli di identità e nei cloud guardrails

• Guidare l'adozione di Zero Trust, meno-privilege e strategie di sicurezza in difesa in profondità attraverso il paesaggio cloud

• Integra i controlli di sicurezza e i requisiti di conformità nelle tubazioni CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) e nei framework di automazione delle piattaforme

• Analisi del rischio e valutazioni di architettura di piombo o di supporto

• Fornire una guida architettonica per la sicurezza della rete e i progetti di connettività in ambienti interni, SaaS e PaaS

• Partner del team Network Architecture per definire standard di rete aziendali e modelli di architettura riutilizzabili, garantendo soluzioni di connettività sicure, scalabili e conformi in tutte le piattaforme e ambienti

• Garantire l'allineamento ai requisiti normativi, di conformità e di sicurezza, traducendoli in soluzioni architettoniche pratiche e implementabili

• Valutare le tecnologie emergenti di sicurezza cloud e migliorare continuamente la postura di sicurezza dell'organizzazione
Collaborazione & Mentoring

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con Cloud Architects, Platform Engineers, team DevOps, operazioni di sicurezza e team di prodotto

• Fornire guida e coaching sull'adozione sicura del cloud

• Aiuta a guidare la trasformazione del cloud e le iniziative di modernizzazione

• Collabora con i team di ingegneria per migliorare l'automazione, l'affidabilità e la sicurezza operativa

## Qualifiche

• Laurea magistrale in Informatica, sicurezza dell'informazione, tecnologia dell'informazione o un campo correlato

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza comprovata come Architetto di Sicurezza Informatica, Architetto di Sicurezza Cloud, o in un ruolo di sicurezza o architettura simile

• Progettazione e gestione di architetture cloud aziendali in Cloud Infrastructure (OCI preferito)

• Esperienza con Cloud Network Architecture, gestione di topologie di rete complesse e argomenti correlati

• Esperienza con valutazioni di rischio, modelli di minacce, recensioni di architettura di sicurezza e metodologie di sicurezza-by-design

• Esperienza pratica con Infrastructure come tecnologie di codice e automazione come Terraform/OpenTofu, pipeline CI/CD, GitOps e Policy-as-Code
Le seguenti certificazioni sono considerate un forte vantaggio:

• CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)

• CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)

• OCI Security Architetto Professional

• Certificazioni OCI in Cloud Security e Network Architecture

• Architetture equivalenti o certificazioni di sicurezza informatica

## Informazioni

Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare ancora la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali.
In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e comprendere il successo del nostro business è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico.
Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altro fantastico tratto che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro.
Si prega di essere consapevoli che non accetteremo le candidature speculative per uno qualsiasi dei nostri ruoli da agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi presentazione candidato non richiesto sarà esente da eventuali aspettative di pagamento.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 11 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.
We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.

We are looking for a passionate Cloud Security Architect to join our Cloud Architecture team. This role combines cloud architecture and security engineering with automation, and DevSecOps practices to help design and secure next-generation cloud platforms and services.

Your Key Tasks

• Design, govern, and continuously evolve secure cloud architectures for SaaS, PaaS, and internal platforms

• Define and maintain cloud security standards, reusable architecture patterns, reference architectures, and security blueprints

• Embed security-by-design principles into landing zones, tenancy structures, network segmentation, identity models, and cloud guardrails

• Drive the adoption of Zero Trust, least-privilege, and defense-in-depth security strategies across the cloud landscape

• Integrate security controls and compliance requirements into CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and platform automation frameworks

• Lead or support security assessments, threat modeling, risk analysis, and architecture reviews

• Provide architectural guidance for network security and connectivity designs across internal, SaaS, and PaaS environments

• Partner with the Network Architecture team to define enterprise network standards and reusable architecture patterns, ensuring secure, scalable, and compliant connectivity solutions across all platforms and environments

• Ensure alignment with regulatory, compliance, and security requirements, translating them into practical and implementable architectural solutions

• Evaluate emerging cloud security technologies and drive continuous improvements in the organization's security posture
Collaboration & Mentoring

• Work closely with Cloud Architects, Platform Engineers, DevOps teams, Security Operations, and Product teams

• Provide guidance and coaching on secure cloud adoption

• Help drive cloud transformation and modernization initiatives

• Collaborate with engineering teams to improve automation, reliability, and operational security

## Qualifiche

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related field

• Minimum 5 years of proven experience as an IT Security Architect, Cloud Security Architect, or in a similar senior security or architecture role

• Experience designing and governing enterprise cloud architectures in Cloud Infrastructure (OCI preferred)

• Experience with Cloud Network Architecture, managing complex network topologies and related topics

• Experience with risk assessments, threat modeling, security architecture reviews, and security-by-design methodologies

• Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation technologies such as Terraform/OpenTofu, CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, and Policy-as-Code
The following certifications are considered a strong advantage:

• CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)

• CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)

• OCI Security Architect Professional

• OCI certifications in Cloud Security and Network Architecture

• Equivalent architecture or cybersecurity certifications

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As the Head of Reporting for Sales and Delivery, you are accountable for the integrity, consistency and transparency of performance reporting across Sales and Project portfolios. You own the reporting frameworks, data governance standards and analytics architecture that enable reliable, decision-ready insights.
You will lead a team of professionals and drive the evolution of our reporting landscape, ensuring that data, tools and processes are structured to maximize analytical value. This is a strategic leadership role focused on translating complex data into actionable insights and enabling confident, data-driven decision-making at senior leadership level.
Your key tasks

• Own and evolve the end-to-end reporting landscape across Sales and Delivery, driving standardization of reporting frameworks, KPI definitions, data governance and tool architecture

• Deliver executive-level performance visibility by preparing and consolidating reporting for senior stakeholders (e.g. GEB, NEC), ensuring clarity, consistency and comparability of insights

• Lead performance review cadences, including Quarterly Review Sessions, providing structured analysis of performance against KPIs, trends and risks

• Act as a strategic advisor to business leaders, translating data into actionable insights to support operational performance and decision-making

• Lead and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement

• Drive the design and optimization of reporting tools and data models to enable scalable analytics and improved data accessibility

• Build strong cross-functional relationships, aligning reporting structures with business needs and ensuring adoption of governance standards through training and stakeholder engagement
What “Great” Looks Like in This Role

• Create one version of the truth across Sales and Delivery

• Turn reporting from a retrospective activity into a decision engine

• Establish clear governance without slowing down the business

• Enable leadership to act with confidence in the data

## Qualifiche

• Proven experience in a senior reporting, analytics, or performance management role, ideally within Sales, Delivery, or a comparable commercial environment

• Experience working with senior stakeholders (e.g. executive committees or board-level audiences), translating complex data into clear, actionable insights

• Strong understanding of CRM and project management systems and how to structure data for scalable analytics

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 160 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.

We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join Avaloq in a Senior Project Manager role, where you will get the opportunity to manage projects within our Product & Development organization, supporting the build and roll-out of new product functionalities or components, to our market-leading clients.
As a key member of our Product Delivery & Quality organization, you will be responsible for leading and delivering complex projects from inception to completion, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
Your key tasks

• Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans (regulatory and/ or innovation projects), including timelines and budgets, communicating with internal stakeholders (kernel development teams), Regional stakeholders, clients, etc.

• Manage Scope, Risks, Issues, and Quality along the entire lifecycle and in alignment with Top Management / C-suite executives

• Develop mitigation strategies to treat risks and resolve issues as they arise

• Effectively communicate and provide weekly project status, progress, and potential roadblocks to Top Management / C-suite executives

• Bridge the gap between product vision and delivery-oriented approach – ensuring deadlines are met according to the project timeline

• Lead cross-divisions / cross-functional project teams to achieve project objectives and milestones

• Oversee project budgets, ensuring Estimate To Complete (ETC) are constantly reviewed according to the project progress

• Conduct post-project evaluations to identify areas for improvement and lessons learned

• Mentor and develop junior project managers and team members

## Qualifiche

• 8-10 years of Project Management experience, with a track record of successfully delivering complex cross-functional projects, at a senior level, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS and/or BPaaS contexts

• Proven track record of delivering results in a complex international and diverse environment

• Strong knowledge of different project management methodologies (e.g.: Waterfall, Agile, etc.) and software (e.g.: Microsoft Project, Jira, etc.)

• Outstanding communication and presentation abilities, combined with natural ability to manage stakeholders at all levels

• Demonstrated ability to manage risks and develop effective treatment strategies

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines

• Strong experience managing end-to end execution of complex programs that span multiple and cross-functional teams through software project lifecycle

• Exceptional leadership and team motivation skills

• Aptitude to discuss technical details with developers and drive consensus among all stakeholders

• Fluency in English, German is an asset
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent

• Experience in leading RFI&RFP processes, vendor negotiation, contracting, hiring, and managing third parties

• Relevant exposure to financial services industry

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 160 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.

We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join Avaloq in a Senior Project Manager role, where you will get the opportunity to manage projects within our Product & Development organization, supporting the build and roll-out of new product functionalities or components, to our market-leading clients.
As a key member of our Product Delivery & Quality organization, you will be responsible for leading and delivering complex projects from inception to completion, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
Your key tasks

• Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans (regulatory and/ or innovation projects), including timelines and budgets, communicating with internal stakeholders (kernel development teams), Regional stakeholders, clients, etc.

• Manage Scope, Risks, Issues, and Quality along the entire lifecycle and in alignment with Top Management / C-suite executives

• Develop mitigation strategies to treat risks and resolve issues as they arise

• Effectively communicate and provide weekly project status, progress, and potential roadblocks to Top Management / C-suite executives

• Bridge the gap between product vision and delivery-oriented approach – ensuring deadlines are met according to the project timeline

• Lead cross-divisions / cross-functional project teams to achieve project objectives and milestones

• Oversee project budgets, ensuring Estimate To Complete (ETC) are constantly reviewed according to the project progress

• Conduct post-project evaluations to identify areas for improvement and lessons learned

• Mentor and develop junior project managers and team members

## Qualifiche

• 8-10 years of Project Management experience, with a track record of successfully delivering complex cross-functional projects, at a senior level, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS and/or BPaaS contexts

• Proven track record of delivering results in a complex international and diverse environment

• Strong knowledge of different project management methodologies (e.g.: Waterfall, Agile, etc.) and software (e.g.: Microsoft Project, Jira, etc.)

• Outstanding communication and presentation abilities, combined with natural ability to manage stakeholders at all levels

• Demonstrated ability to manage risks and develop effective treatment strategies

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines

• Strong experience managing end-to end execution of complex programs that span multiple and cross-functional teams through software project lifecycle

• Exceptional leadership and team motivation skills

• Aptitude to discuss technical details with developers and drive consensus among all stakeholders

• Fluency in English, German is an asset
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent

• Experience in leading RFI&RFP processes, vendor negotiation, contracting, hiring, and managing third parties

• Relevant exposure to financial services industry

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

Wir sind uns bewusst, dass die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben eine Herausforderung darstellt, mit der wir alle in unserem täglichen Leben konfrontiert sind. Um dies zu unterstützen, freuen wir uns, den meisten unserer Avaloq-Mitarbeiter hybride und flexible Arbeitsmodelle anbieten zu können, um die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben aufrechtzuerhalten und dennoch unsere fantastische Avaloq-Kultur in unseren weltweiten Niederlassungen fortzuführen.

Wir stellen ein, entlohnen und fördern unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung oder anderen fantastischen Eigenschaften, die uns alle einzigartig machen. Wir haben unser Bestes getan, diese Anzeige in einer inklusiven und neutralen Art und Weise zu verfassen.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 10 countries, and more than 160 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.
We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.

As a Project Manager, you will lead complex client implementation projects, coordinating cross-functional teams to deliver Avaloq's BPaaS and SaaS solutions on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
Your key tasks

• Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of change-the-bank projects for Avaloq's major global banking clients. This includes working with the relevant Avaloq units (Solution Architects/Consultants, Infrastructure, Support Services, Regional Banking Operations, customer representatives, etc.) and partner resources, where applicable, to define project objectives and execute the agreed project plan.

• Prepare project budgets and commercial offers in close cooperation with Avaloq Solution Architects/Consultants and Key Account Managers for submission to and negotiation with prospective and existing customers.

• Achieve the defined project objectives, including scope, quality, timelines, budget, reporting, project staffing (internal Avaloq and external partners), and post-project reviews.

• Consult and coach customer project managers and teams to leverage best practices and business processes reflected in Avaloq's Banking Reference.

• Lead projects concurrently while supporting pre-sales activities and proposals for prospective clients.

• Ensure deliverables are completed on time and meet the required quality standards.

## Qualifiche

• Proven track record as the overall project leader for large-scale projects, preferably involving the implementation of standard software solutions

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Business Economics, Engineering, or a related field

• Project Management certification from a recognized accrediting body

• Knowledge of the banking industry and bank-related processes

• Strong negotiation skills with proven experience engaging stakeholders up to Steering Committee level

• Leadership experience in managing interdisciplinary and multicultural teams

• Persistent, assertive, and resilient, with the ability to maintain an overview and set priorities effectively

• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Experience in international change-the-bank platform projects

• PMP certification

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Als Projektmanager leiten Sie komplexe Kundenimplementierungsprojekte und koordinieren funktionsübergreifende Teams, um die BPaaS- und SaaS-Lösungen von Avaloq pünktlich, innerhalb des Budgets und nach höchsten Qualitätsstandards zu liefern.
Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben

• Führen Sie die Planung, Durchführung und Lieferung von Change-the-Bank-Projekten für die wichtigsten globalen Bankkunden von Avaloq. Dazu gehört die Zusammenarbeit mit den relevanten Avaloq-Einheiten (Solution Architects/Consultants, Infrastructure, Support Services, Regional Banking Operations, Kundenvertreter, etc.) und gegebenenfalls Partnerressourcen, um Projektziele zu definieren und den vereinbarten Projektplan auszuführen.

• Bereiten Sie Projektbudgets und kommerzielle Angebote in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Avaloq Solution Architects/Consultants und Key Account Managern für die Einreichung und Verhandlung mit potenziellen und bestehenden Kunden vor.

• Erreichen der definierten Projektziele, einschließlich Umfang, Qualität, Zeitpläne, Budget, Berichterstattung, Projektpersonal (interne Avaloq und externe Partner) und Überprüfungen nach dem Projekt.

• Konsultieren und coachen Sie Projektmanager und Teams von Kunden, um Best Practices und Geschäftsprozesse zu nutzen, die sich in der Banking Reference von Avaloq widerspiegeln.

• Führen Sie gleichzeitig Projekte und unterstützen Sie Pre-Sales-Aktivitäten und Vorschläge für potenzielle Kunden.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Lieferungen pünktlich abgeschlossen werden und die erforderlichen Qualitätsstandards erfüllen.

## Qualifiziert

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz als Gesamtprojektleiter bei Großprojekten, vorzugsweise bei der Implementierung von Standardsoftwarelösungen

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Informationstechnologie, Betriebswirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung durch eine anerkannte Akkreditierungsstelle

• Kenntnisse der Bankenbranche und bankbezogene Prozesse

• Starkes Verhandlungsgeschick mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung bei der Einbeziehung von Stakeholdern bis hin zur Ebene des Lenkungsausschusses

• Führungserfahrung im Management interdisziplinärer und multikultureller Teams

• Anhaltend, durchsetzungsfähig und belastbar, mit der Fähigkeit, den Überblick zu behalten und Prioritäten effektiv zu setzen

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und Präsentation Fähigkeiten in Englisch
Es wäre ein echter Bonus, wenn Sie

• Erfahrung in internationalen Change-the-Bank-Plattformprojekten

• PMP-Zertifizierung

## Informazioni aggiuntive

Wir wissen, dass das Management der Work-Life-Balance eine Herausforderung ist, der wir alle in unserem täglichen Leben gegenüberstehen, und um dies zu unterstützen, freuen wir uns, den meisten unserer Avaloqer ein hybrides und flexibles Arbeiten anzubieten, um die Work-Life-Balance zu erhalten und unsere fantastische Avaloq-Kultur in unseren globalen Büros fortzusetzen.
Bei Avaloq sind wir stolz darauf, Vielfalt anzunehmen und zu verstehen, dass der Erfolg unseres Unternehmens auf der Kraft unterschiedlicher Meinungen basiert, wir sind von ganzem Herzen bestrebt, eine Chancengleichheit und eine integrative Kultur zu fördern, in der Sie Ihr wahres authentisches Selbst sein können.
Wir stellen, kompensieren und fördern unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung oder anderen fantastischen Eigenschaften, die uns alle einzigartig machen, wir haben unser Bestes getan, um diese Anzeige in einer integrativen und neutralen Weise zu schreiben.
Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir keine spekulativen CV-Einreichungen für unsere Rollen von Rekrutierungsagenturen annehmen werden und dass unerwünschte Kandidateneinreichungen von Zahlungserwartungen ausgenommen sind.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que gestionnaire de projet, vous dirigerez des projets complexes de mise en oeuvre client, coordonnant des équipes interfonctionnelles pour fournir les solutions BPaaS et SaaS d'Avaloq dans les délais, dans les limites du budget et selon les normes de qualité les plus élevées.
Vos tâches clés

• Diriger la planification, l'exécution et la réalisation de projets de changement de banque pour les principaux clients bancaires mondiaux d'Avaloq. Cela comprend la collaboration avec les unités concernées d'Avaloq (architectes/conseils en solutions, infrastructure, services de soutien, opérations bancaires régionales, représentants des clients, etc.) et les ressources des partenaires, le cas échéant, pour définir les objectifs du projet et exécuter le plan de projet convenu.

• Préparer des budgets de projets et des offres commerciales en étroite collaboration avec Avaloq Solution Architects/Consultants et Key Account Managers pour soumission et négociation avec les clients potentiels et existants.

• Atteindre les objectifs définis du projet, y compris la portée, la qualité, les délais, le budget, les rapports, la dotation en personnel du projet (Avaloque interne et partenaires externes) et les examens postérieurs au projet.

• Consultez et coachez les gestionnaires de projets clients et les équipes pour tirer parti des meilleures pratiques et des processus opérationnels reflétés dans la référence bancaire d'Avaloq.

• Diriger les projets simultanément tout en appuyant les activités et les propositions préalables à la vente pour les clients éventuels.

• S'assurer que les produits livrables sont terminés à temps et qu'ils respectent les normes de qualité requises.

## Qualifiche

• Expérience éprouvée en tant que chef de projet global pour des projets à grande échelle, impliquant de préférence la mise en œuvre de solutions logicielles standard

• Baccalauréat en technologie de l'information, administration des affaires, économie des affaires, génie ou un domaine connexe

• Certification de gestion de projet d'un organisme d'accréditation reconnu

• Connaissance du secteur bancaire et des processus liés aux banques

• Fortes compétences en négociation avec une expérience éprouvée faisant participer les intervenants jusqu'au niveau du comité directeur

• Expérience de leadership dans la gestion des équipes interdisciplinaires et multiculturelles

• Résistant, affirmé et résilient, avec la capacité de maintenir un aperçu et de fixer des priorités efficacement

• Excellentes compétences en communication et présentation en anglais
Ce serait un vrai bonus si vous aviez

• Expérience des projets internationaux de plateforme de changement de banque

• Certification PMP

## Informations complémentaires

Nous nous rendons compte que la gestion de l'équilibre de vie au travail est un défi auquel nous sommes tous confrontés dans notre vie quotidienne et pour soutenir avec cela nous sommes heureux d'offrir un travail hybride et flexible pour la plupart de nos Avaloqers pour maintenir l'équilibre de vie au travail et pour continuer notre fantastique culture Avaloq dans nos bureaux mondiaux.
À Avaloq, nous sommes fiers d'embrasser la diversité et de comprendre que le succès de notre entreprise est fondé sur la puissance des différentes opinions, nous sommes tout à fait engagés à favoriser un environnement d'égalité des chances et une culture inclusive où vous pouvez être votre véritable soi authentique.
Nous recrutons, compensons et promouvons indépendamment de l'origine, de l'âge, de l'identité de genre, de l'orientation sexuelle ou de tout autre caractère fantastique qui nous rend uniques, nous avons fait de notre mieux pour écrire cette annonce de manière inclusive et neutre.
Veuillez noter que nous n'accepterons aucune soumission de CV spéculative pour l'un de nos rôles des agences de recrutement, et toute soumission non sollicitée sera exemptée de toute attente de paiement.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Fondata e con sede in Svizzera, Avaloq sta espandendo continuamente la sua impronta globale con circa 2.500 colleghi in 12 paesi, e più di 170 clienti in 35 paesi. Siamo un fornitore leader del settore di tecnologia di gestione della ricchezza e servizi per le istituzioni finanziarie in tutto il mondo, tra cui banche private e gestori di ricchezza, gestori di investimenti, così come al dettaglio e banche neo. La nostra ricerca ha condotto l'approccio e la continua innovazione è alimentata dalla passione e dalla creatività dei nostri colleghi.

Cerchiamo sempre persone di talento per unirsi a noi nella nostra missione di orchestrare l'ecosistema finanziario e democratizzare l'accesso alla gestione della ricchezza. Avaloq offre l’opportunità di lavorare a stretto contatto con alcune delle principali istituzioni finanziarie del mondo, sviluppando e modellando insieme le carriere. Campionere di un ambiente di lavoro collaborativo, di supporto e flessibile consente ai nostri colleghi di raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale.

Banking Operations è una linea di servizio strategica Avaloq che fornisce servizi di outsourcing Banking Operations alle banche. Siamo organizzati come business area globale, in esecuzione di servizi di backoffice all'avanguardia con l'automazione leader del settore, la qualità e gli standard di rischio. Siamo esperti nel fornire un vero valore aggiunto ai nostri clienti e quindi, sempre guardare per aggiungere personalità creative e orientate al cliente con spinta e passione al nostro team.
Sarete parte di un dipartimento globale situato in 3 paesi diversi (Germania, Svizzera e Singapore) responsabile della gestione aziendale/processi di azione aziendale (annuncio, istruzioni e pagamenti).

I compiti chiave
Durante il periodo di stage, sarete in grado di assistere e imparare le seguenti attività, con il supporto del personale senior Banking Operations, oscurando il loro lavoro e avendo l'opportunità di fornire i vostri input e contributo.

• Analisi dei messaggi rapidi del Custode MT564/568. Analisi introduttiva dei messaggi MT564 e MT568 SWIFT ricevuti dai custodi, concentrandosi sull'individuazione degli elementi chiave e sulla comprensione del loro ruolo nel trattamento delle azioni aziendali

• Configurazione degli eventi di Corporate Actions. Sostegno guidato nella creazione di tipi di eventi CA standard e a basso rischio e comprendere i rischi coinvolti e potenziali conseguenze. Ciò è limitato agli scenari di base e alle seguenti procedure predefinite

• Notifiche in varie lingue a clienti finali delle banche per eventi di azioni societarie elettive. Assistenza nell'elaborazione delle notifiche ai clienti finali delle banche, in base ai modelli e alla revisione del personale

• Risoluzione delle richieste del cliente. Osservazione e gestione supervisionata delle richieste dei clienti, con l'obiettivo di apprendere come i processi di risoluzione siano strutturati e gestiti da personale esperto

## Qualifiche

• Studi economici, preferibilmente a livello universitario e con un focus in finanza

• Approccio proattivo verso un ambiente altamente impegnativo, veloce e complesso

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e di organizzazione

• Buon giocatore di squadra e atteggiamento positivo

• Flessibilità e disponibilità ad imparare

• Lingua inglese
Sarebbe un vero bonus se avessi

• Il know-how nell'area Azioni Aziendali (anche se solo teorica) è considerato come un vantaggio forte

• Conoscenza delle lingue aggiuntive (preferibilmente tedesco o francese)

## Informazioni

Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare ancora la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali.
In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e capire che il successo della nostra azienda è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico.
Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altro fantastico tratto che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro.
Si prega di essere consapevoli che non accetteremo le candidature speculative per uno qualsiasi dei nostri ruoli da agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi candidatura non richiesta sarà esente da eventuali aspettative di pagamento.

• Support Cloud Engineers and Developers to build solid automated infrastructure provisioning and configuration

• Proven experience as a Cloud Architect or in a similar role

• Proficiency with automation tools such as Terraform and Ansible is strongly preferred

• Strong communication and collaboration abilities

• A proactive, team-oriented mindset with a passion for innovation

descriptionByLocale.it:
Fondata e con sede in Svizzera, Avaloq sta espandendo continuamente la sua impronta globale con circa 2.500 colleghi in 10 paesi, e più di 160 clienti in 35 paesi. La nostra ricerca ha condotto l'approccio e la continua innovazione è alimentata dalla passione e dalla creatività dei nostri colleghi.

Siamo sempre alla ricerca di persone di talento per unirsi a noi nella nostra missione di orchestrare l'ecosistema finanziario e democratizzare l'accesso alla gestione della ricchezza. Avaloq offre l’opportunità di lavorare a stretto contatto con alcune delle principali istituzioni finanziarie del mondo, sviluppando e modellando insieme le carriere. Campione di un ambiente di lavoro collaborativo, solidale e flessibile, consente ai nostri colleghi di raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale.

Siamo gli esperti delle soluzioni End-to-end Payments and Cash Operations di Avaloq e mantengono, migliorano e innovano i moduli associati in tutti gli strati del software, dalla configurazione specifica del cliente per i nostri clienti SaaS, Avaloq Banking Standard (ABR/S) per i vari mercati, fino allo sviluppo più interno per ciascuno dei nostri clienti.
Unisciti al nostro team di pagamento globale, che comprende sviluppatori di software di talento, analisti di business e consulenti provenienti da tutto il mondo, collaborando in un ambiente dinamico e innovativo. Diventa un esperto di materia di fiducia (SME) nella tua area funzionale, assumendo una vasta gamma di incarichi che ti terranno sfidato e impegnato.
Stiamo cercando uno sviluppatore software esperto che valorizza l'interazione del cliente e prospera su strati di personalizzazione di artigianato che migliorano l'esperienza dell'utente.
In cambio del vostro impegno per questo ruolo, avrete un'opportunità unica per esplorare la vostra area di competenza all'interno dei vari mercati e per svolgere un ruolo attivo lungo l'intera catena del valore. Inoltre, forniamo un ambiente di lavoro moderno con orari di lavoro flessibili, la capacità di lavorare da casa e processi di sviluppo software agili.
I compiti chiave

• Progettare soluzioni innovative per nuovi sviluppi in collaborazione con i nostri tecnici e architetti.

• Implementare funzionalità aziendali all'avanguardia, allineare con gli strati software appropriati e migliorare l'affidabilità tramite test automatizzati.

• Prendere la piena proprietà dei vostri moduli, lavorando a stretto contatto con il vostro team per mantenere e ottimizzare la funzionalità.

• Promuovere la collaborazione con colleghi sia all'interno del team che in tutti i dipartimenti, costruendo forti partnership per il successo.

## Qualifiche

• Una laurea in informatica o equivalente

• Un interesse per le banche

• Capacità di programmazione eccellenti

• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving

• Forte focus del cliente e capacità di comunicazione in inglese

• Motivazione e una mentalità collaborativa con un approccio strutturato al tuo lavoro

• Un desiderio di crescere, imparare e lavorare sui vari livelli software
Sarebbe un vero bonus se avessi

• Esperienza nel settore finanziario

• Conoscenza dei sistemi PL/SQL e di database relazionali

• Business know-how nei pagamenti

• Esperienza di metodologie agili

Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altro fantastico tratto che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro.
Si prega di essere consapevoli che non accetteremo le candidature speculative per uno qualsiasi dei nostri ruoli da agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi presentazione candidato non richiesto sarà esente da eventuali aspettative di pagamento.

Become a trusted subject matter expert (SME)  within your functional area, taking on a diverse range of assignments that will keep you challenged and engaged.

In return for your commitment to this role, you will have a unique opportunity to explore your area of expertise within the various markets and to play an active part along the entire value chain. Furthermore, we provide a modern working environment with flexible working hours, the ability to work from home, and agile software development processes.
Your key tasks

• Design innovative solutions  for new developments in collaboration with our technical leads and architects.

• Implement cutting-edge business functionality , aligning with the appropriate software layers and enhancing reliability through automated testing.

• Take full ownership  of your modules, working closely with your team to maintain and optimize functionality.

• Foster collaboration  with colleagues both within the team and across departments, building strong partnerships for success.

## Qualifiche

• A university degree in computer science or equivalent

• An interest in banking

• Excellent programming skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Strong client focus and communication skills in English

• Motivation and a collaborative mindset along with a structured approach to your work

• An eagerness to grow, learn and work on the various software layers
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Experience in the financial industry

• Knowledge of PL/SQL and relational database systems

• Business know-how in Payments

• Experience of agile methodologies

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.
